scope: Embedded shipping PLAY.html, diagnostics enabled only in memory. Fault-injection tests identified explicitly. No HTTP/file navigation or real Safari/device certification.

tests.name: Branding: no prototype masthead, footers, edition labels or shortcut banner
Real first click unlocks original music without autoplay overrides
Four authored stems decode, contain signal and share the authored loop duration
Menu, gameplay and trial mixes change without restarting synchronized stems
Single mute button silences both music and effects and restores output
Independent master, music and effects sliders reach separate buses with a quiet probe tone
Disabling typewriter effects leaves the music playing
Music toggle fades rather than resetting playback or disabling effects
Repeated modal transitions do not duplicate music sources
Pause and nested Settings freeze play, soften music, and make obscured controls inert
Resume countdown holds the simulation still before returning control
Escape cancels a pending countdown without accidental resume
Focus loss cancels countdown, suspends audio and requires deliberate gameplay resume
Countdown restores the exact word, cursor and selected range
Countdown preference provides immediate resume when disabled
First-use typing hint retires on success and respects its preference
Focused HUD removes secondary numbers; detailed HUD can restore them
Reduced motion removes decorative animation without hiding ready states
Burst effects respect voice limits and disconnect after playback
Injected missing music failure reports honestly while typing remains playable
AudioContext-unavailable environment still starts gameplay
Final title, gameplay, Audio settings and chapter atlas render into captures
Unmodified production PLAY.html exposes no controlled test seam
No unhandled application errors during polish audit
